text:
### Escalation Etiquette  
- ✅ DO provide complete context (don't make escalation authority investigate)
- ✅ DO include recommendation (show you've thought it through)
- ✅ DO be responsive (answer authority questions quickly)
- ✅ DO follow decision (implement without second-guessing)
- ❌ DON'T escalate until you've tried resolution at your level
- ❌ DON'T escalate again if already decided (only if circumstances change)
- ❌ DON'T escalate trivial issues (know your authority limit)

raw_entities.name: Escalation Procedure
raw_entities.description: A procedural framework governing when and how operational issues should be escalated to higher authority levels. The procedure establishes best practices for escalation communication, including requirements to provide complete context, include recommendations, maintain responsiveness, and follow decisions without second-guessing. It also defines constraints on escalation, prohibiting premature escalation before attempting resolution at the current level, re-escalation of already-decided matters, and escalation of trivial issues.
context: DO provide complete context (don't make escalation authority investigate)
DO include recommendation (show you've thought it through)
DON'T escalate until you've tried resolution at your level
DON'T escalate trivial issues (know your authority limit)

raw_entities.name: Context Provision for Escalation
raw_entities.description: The step of providing complete context to the escalation authority to enable informed decision-making without requiring the authority to conduct their own investigation.
context: DO provide complete context (don't make escalation authority investigate)

raw_entities.name: Recommendation Formulation for Escalation
raw_entities.description: The step of including a reasoned recommendation when escalating an issue, demonstrating that the escalating party has already considered the matter and formed a view on the appropriate resolution.
context: DO include recommendation (show you've thought it through)

raw_entities.name: Responsive Communication During Escalation
raw_entities.description: The step of maintaining responsiveness to questions and requests from the escalation authority, ensuring timely answers to support the escalation decision-making process.
context: DO be responsive (answer authority questions quickly)

raw_entities.name: Decision Implementation After Escalation
raw_entities.description: The step of implementing the escalation authority's decision without second-guessing or re-evaluating the decision once it has been made.
context: DO follow decision (implement without second-guessing)

raw_entities.name: Resolution Attempt at Current Level
raw_entities.description: The mandatory step of attempting to resolve an issue at the current authority level before escalating to a higher level, establishing a prerequisite condition for escalation.
context: DON'T escalate until you've tried resolution at your level

raw_entities.name: Escalation Necessity Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate determining whether an issue should be escalated to higher authority or resolved at the current level. The gate enforces that escalation should only occur after resolution attempts at the current level have been exhausted, and that trivial issues within the current authority's limit should not be escalated.
context: DON'T escalate until you've tried resolution at your level
DON'T escalate trivial issues (know your authority limit)

raw_entities.name: Re-escalation Prohibition Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate preventing re-escalation of matters that have already been decided by higher authority, unless material circumstances have changed since the original decision.
context: DON'T escalate again if already decided (only if circumstances change)

raw_entities.name: Escalating Staff Member
raw_entities.description: The operational staff member responsible for initiating escalation, who must attempt resolution at their level first, provide complete context and recommendations, and remain responsive to the escalation authority's questions.
context: DO provide complete context (don't make escalation authority investigate)
DON'T escalate until you've tried resolution at your level

raw_entities.name: Escalation Authority
raw_entities.description: The higher-level authority responsible for receiving escalations, making decisions on escalated matters, and whose decisions must be implemented by the escalating staff member without second-guessing.
context: DO follow decision (implement without second-guessing)
don't make escalation authority investigate
